content_based.primary_strength: Solves item cold start, domain specific similarity
content_based.limitation: Overspecialization, cannot recommend across different genres

collaborative.primary_strength: Discovers cross-genre unexpected favorites, leverages community taste
collaborative.limitation: Suffers from cold start problem on new users/items

hybrid.primary_strength: Combines item metadata with collaborative user ratings
hybrid.limitation: Higher computational overhead than single models
